lines.speaker: d
lines.text: I have a question.
What is it?

lines.speaker: d
lines.text: Sometimes, when I'm passing through an alley,

lines.speaker: d
lines.text: I can sense that people are afraid of me.

lines.speaker: d
lines.text: Do you have any idea why that is?
I might have a slight idea why...
Maybe you were just imagining things.

lines.speaker: d
lines.text: Why?

lines.speaker: d
lines.text: No, this was no figment of my imagination.

lines.speaker: d
lines.text: The moment I made eye contact with them,

lines.speaker: d
lines.text: they'd yelp and avert their gaze.
Were you holding your axe?

lines.speaker: d
lines.text: Huh?

lines.speaker: d
lines.text: Of course I was.
Do you see how that could perhaps be an issue?

lines.speaker: d
lines.text: Why would it be?

lines.speaker: d
lines.text: I wasn't chasing anyone or even brandishing it.

lines.speaker: d
lines.text: You know that I don't kill innocent people.
Be that as it may, a weapon is a weapon.
D doesn't reply for a while.

lines.speaker: d
lines.text: So what should I do?
Don't walk around brandishing your axe when you're not on an assignment.
When you're out and about, always be smiling.

lines.speaker: d
lines.text: No can do.

lines.speaker: d
lines.text: I never know when I'll be given an assignment.
Okay then. When you're out and about, always be smiling.

lines.speaker: d
lines.text: Are you trying to be funny? Why would I do that?
Smiling is the best way to leave a good impression.

lines.speaker: d
lines.text: Hmm.

lines.speaker: d
lines.text: Is it?

lines.speaker: d
lines.text: Got it.

lines.speaker: d
lines.text: I'll try it out right away.
It's raining outside.
How about waiting until it's sunny out?
D doesn't reply. She must have gone out.

lines.speaker: d
lines.text: I did what you said.

lines.speaker: d
lines.text: Everyone ran away in a panic.

lines.speaker: d
lines.text: So much for your bright idea.
... Sorry.

lines.speaker: d
lines.text: You have nothing to apologize for.

lines.speaker: d
lines.text: We'll just have to come up with another solution.

lines.speaker: d
lines.text: we should figure another way out.

lines.speaker: d
lines.text: I'll let you know if I come up with anything.
Me too.
